programmes.d: While in the process of adopting a five-week-old baby, a mother takes him to work with her. While there, the baby inexplicably obtains a skull fracture while unsupervised.
On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.
An employee is found dead in a restaurant kitchen. Clues found near the body include an empty cash register, a knife, and a trail of blood splotches leading to a vandalized car in the parking lot.
A healthy 53-year-old woman is found dead in bed. After performing an autopsy and taking blood and tissue samples, Dr. G cannot find the cause of death.
A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn’t what it seems.
Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple hasn’t seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.
Recent college grad Robert Terrible is out drinking at a club with friends celebrating. At 3 AM, he realizes he better call it a night and heads to the nearby garage where he parked his car.

A jewelry shop owner is shot point blank in the chest during a robbery and within minutes is undergoing emergency open-heart surgery.
A boy suffers from a massive brain hemorrhage after being hit by a baseball bat. He is rushed to surgery, where it's discovered that he also has kidney failure.
Kassie arrives and is diagnosed with pneumonia. Dr Tellez devises a treatment that has never been attempted before. Will he win the gamble?
The force of a tornado drove a fence picket through Julie's neck. With it blocking her airways, the only way of saving her is to pull it out.
Seven-year-old Brian has been hit by a truck and his arm has been ripped off. In a ten-hour operation, Dr Gottlieb attempts to re-attach the arm.
Jarret is rushed into ER after being violently tackled in a football game. A CAT scan reveals that his liver is split and he needs emergency surgery.
A skier clings to life after slamming into a tree at 50mph. By the time he reaches the hospital he's a talking corpse.
A six-year-old Chinese girl is rushed in with intermittent seizures, but with a language barrier, will the doctor find out what's wrong with her?
More than 1,000lbs of dry wall crush onto a young boy's chest, stopping blood circulation to his vital organs. Doctors fear the worst.
Gripping tales of medical emergencies. Doctors must look after their own when a psychotic gunman enters the hospital and starts shooting staff. Dr May is shot in the head, but can his colleague save.
A mother and son are brought in after a horrific car accident. The son was not wearing a seat belt during the crash and was ejected from the car.
A police man is struck by a speeding driver seeking revenge, which may leave him with no legs. A team of doctors try and save the officer's life.
It’s an early Sunday morning when a local resident decides to take a shortcut through the church parking lot. Walking past a lone car, the resident can’t believe his eyes.
It is 3 AM and Deputy Torres is cruising a Texas highway when he suddenly spots a crushed pick-up truck along the side of the road. Trapped inside is the lifeless body of 24-year-old Luis Reyes.
Carol Moleskie agrees to go on a hunting excursion with her husband, Bob. A few hours after they enter the woods, they emerge again, Bob frantically waving down traffic as he carries his bloody wife.
It’s a late night and a Vietnam veteran with a history of mental illness is drunk and stumbling through an apartment complex. When the police arrive, he pulls a gun and shoots himself in the head.
Jeffrey Ortiz, a mentally challenged man with the mental capacity of a nine-year-old, is making himself a sandwich when he inexplicably falls, striking his head on the kitchen counter.
When the husband, Tao Chen, is shot to death by his wife Jun, she claims she pulled the trigger in self-defense when a drunken Tao came after her with a gun.
After a brief illness, 34-year old Claire Jackson dies suddenly in the hospital from massive liver failure and winds up in Dr. G’s morgue.
A quadriplegic woman loved by her community is found dead in an Orlando park 150ft from her motorized wheelchair. Children find her lifeless body face down in the sand.
